svg.title: Fixed Point — the hour this watcher cannot prove
svg.desc: The openrappter watcher's own rapp/1 chain, drawn twice. Above: its 14 frames placed at the times it actually recorded, spanning 47 minutes 40 seconds. Below: the same 14 frames after every timestamp was replaced, compressed to 13 milliseconds. Both readings pass every rapp/1 section 7.5 check, because prev binds the predecessor's payload_hash and payload_hash does not cover utc. The gold ring is the self-loop: nine consecutive attestations whose payloads are identical, so each one's prev equals its own payload_hash. This watcher measures nothing but time, in the one field its chain does not hold.
svg.metadata: {"schema":"rapp-art-evidence/1.0","stream_id":"rappid:@kody-w/watcher-openrappter:3037fe56aabf5dd5742658cb37ed30d004e690574de48f256e46c5843af9405f","claim":"On an unsigned particle (non-swarm) rapp/1 stream, `utc` is not chain-bound: prev links the predecessor's payload_hash (SPEC §7.4), payload_hash does not cover utc, and prev_wave — which would bind frame_hash, and through it utc — MUST be null off-swarm. Rewriting every utc and resealing each frame_hash leaves all §7.5 checks passing. Altering a payload, or removing a frame, does not.","reproduce":"For each frame: payload_hash == H('rapp/1:particle', payload); frame_hash == H('rapp/1:wave', frame minus {frame_hash,sig}); seq == prev_frame.seq+1; prev == prev_frame.payload_hash; utc >= prev_frame.utc. H(space,v) = sha256(space || 0x0a || JCS(v)). Then replace every utc with any ascending sequence, recompute frame_hash, and re-run: still passes.","observed":{"frames":14,"signed":0,"distinct_payload_hash":3,"real_span_ms":2860237,"redated_span_ms":13,"self_loop_frames":[2,3,4,5,6,7,8,9,10],"self_loop_hash":"59c71536df6ecdbef23a73bce6743fb20c97a57eb379902b7ec092494981c6d6","baseline_verifies":true,"redated_verifies":true},"chain":[{"seq":0,"utc":"2026-08-04T00:53:30.965Z","kind":"watcher.heartbeat","payload":{"role":"the svg.text: the hour this watcher cannot prove

g.text: 47m 40s of watching, at the intervals it logged
the same 14 frames, every timestamp replaced, 13ms end to end
seq 2–10 · nine assurances, identical but for seq and utc

svg.text: Solid links are chain-bound - alter a payload and the next frame's prev refuses it; cut one and seq refuses it.
The dashed rule under each row is utc, and nothing downstream holds it. Both rows are the same chain.
Every frame here is unsigned; §10 signatures cover frame_hash and would have held the hour. Chain embedded in <metadata>.
